# AfuChat Mail

> Hosted professional email at email.afuchat.com: @afuchat.com addresses, aliases, custom domains, and an OAuth 2.0 API for third-party apps.

AfuChat Mail is an ad-free email client and mail host. People sign up for an @afuchat.com address, add aliases, connect their own verified domains on paid plans, and read or send mail from the web app, the Telegram mini app, or the REST API.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What AfuChat Mail is and how to get an address.
- [Features](/features): Aliases, threads, snooze, scheduled send, offline access, notifications.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Starter (free), Professional, and Business plans with storage and domain limits.
- [Solutions](/solutions): How founders, teams, agencies, and developers use AfuChat Mail.
- [About](/about): Who builds AfuChat Mail and why.
- [Contact](/contact): Support, billing, and partnership contacts.
- [Help Center](/help): Guides for addresses, aliases, custom domains, and recovery email.
- [Security](/security): How mailboxes and data are protected.
- [Status](/status): Live availability of delivery, inbound mail, auth, and the API.
